FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about sales and stock reports

Can I review sales by product?

The audited feature set includes product-level sales visibility.

What is the difference between net and gross?

Net generally excludes applicable tax while gross includes it; confirm the active tax configuration.

Does inventory value replace accounting valuation?

No. Use the available operational summary and reconcile it with your accounting method.

Are report figures live customer data on this page?

No. Marketing-page examples use fictional demonstration values.
